overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Weston Public Works & Utility Committee was scheduled to meet on September 14, 2026, to address multiple infrastructure projects including street reconstructions, utility easements, and operational updates. The meeting was set to discuss capital improvement projects, various street and utility assessments, and policy matters affecting village infrastructure.

agenda.item: Approval of 8/10/26 Public Works & Utility Committee Minutes
Acknowledge August 2026 Water and Sewer Permits
Business 51 Reconstruction – Neupert Ave Pedestrian Crossing
Ferge Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
Howland Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
Alderson St and Jelinek Ave Change Order #2

discussions.item: Business 51 Reconstruction – Neupert Ave Pedestrian Crossing
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review this pedestrian crossing project in detail, with additional information expected to be presented following a deferral from the August meeting. Discussion was set to address impacts on local businesses, parking lots, signage, and project costs, potentially including City of Schofield's involvement.

The committee was scheduled to consider a sanitary sewer easement request with additional information anticipated after being deferred from the August meeting. The discussion was set to include review of easement agreements and the potential value of a survey to confirm alignment with previous property surveys.

discussions.item: Ferge Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
discussions.body: The committee was set to discuss typical section design standards for the Ferge Avenue project as part of ongoing street improvement planning.

discussions.item: Howland Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review and discuss typical section design standards for the Howland Avenue project.
The committee was set to discuss maintenance practices and standards for village gravel roads.
The committee was scheduled to consider final special assessments for the East Jelinek Avenue project.
The committee was set to review and consider final special assessments for the Weston Avenue project, which was noted as 100% complete in both east and west construction phases.

discussions.item: Alderson St and Jelinek Ave Change Order #2
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review the second change order related to the Alderson Street and Jelinek Avenue projects.
The committee was set to discuss proposed updates to the village's winter street parking ordinance.

The committee was scheduled to receive an update on the status of ongoing Capital Improvement Plan projects, with comparative analysis of the village's street spending relative to neighboring communities in Central Wisconsin.
The committee was set to receive a staff report on street operations activities and status.
The committee was scheduled to receive a staff report on utility operations activities and status.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda.
